name: hero
description: Responsive marketing hero with badge, eyebrow, headline, copy, actions and an optional media slot.
designIntent: Landing pages repeat a headline cluster with an optional product shot. Hero standardizes the hierarchy and four responsive layouts (split, centered, stacked, overlay) while leaving the band tone and padding to Section.

props.name: title
props.description: Main headline. Accepts inline markup for a highlighted phrase.

props.name: badge
props.description: Pill above the headline for an announcement, category or proof point.

props.name: actions
props.description: Primary and secondary calls to action.

props.name: media
props.description: Product shot, illustration, video or form shown beside or behind the copy.

props.name: mediaPosition
props.description: Which side the media sits on at lg and up in the split layout.

props.name: align
props.description: Copy alignment. Centered is typically used without media.

props.name: level
props.description: Heading level. Use 2 when the hero is nested under a page h1.

props.name: variant
props.description: Layout. split puts copy and media side by side at lg and up; centered stacks copy in a narrow column; stacked puts copy above full-width media; overlay places media behind the copy with a theme-aware scrim. Defaults to split when media is provided and centered without it.

props.name: titleClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the headline, for host display typography.

props.name: badgeClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the badge wrapper.

props.name: mediaClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the media wrapper.

examples.title: Split hero
examples.code:
<Section tone="inverse">
  <Hero
    badge="The private deal network"
    title="Find your next buyer."
    description="Join 20,000+ investors and advisors."
    actions={<Button>Get started</Button>}
    media={<ProductMockup />}
  />
</Section>
examples.description: Copy on the left, product media on the right; stacks on small screens.

examples.title: Reversed split hero
examples.code:
<Hero
  mediaPosition="left"
  eyebrow="Network overview"
  title="A fragmented market, made easier"
  description="Current activity across the network."
  media={<ProductMockup />}
/>
examples.description: Media on the left at lg and up without changing DOM order.

examples.title: Centered hero
examples.code:
<Hero
  align="center"
  eyebrow="Network overview"
  title="A fragmented market, made easier"
  description="Current activity across the network."
/>
examples.description: A narrow centered hero for a page band.

examples.title: Stacked hero
examples.code:
<Hero
  variant="stacked"
  eyebrow="Product tour"
  title="Every deal in one workspace"
  description="Understand the pipeline before the first call."
  media={<DashboardScreenshot />}
/>
examples.description: Copy above full-width media, useful for wide screenshots.

antiPatterns.title: Don't use Hero as the only page heading twice
antiPatterns.explanation: A page should have one h1. Use level={2} for a second hero-like band or PageHeader for documentation pages.
antiPatterns.example:
// Avoid two h1s
<Hero title="Page" /><Hero title="Another page" />

antiPatterns.title: Don't hardcode the band color
antiPatterns.explanation: Wrap Hero in Section and use its tone so child tokens stay readable.

antiPatterns.title: Don't put busy media behind overlay copy
antiPatterns.explanation: The overlay scrim protects contrast, but high-detail media still hurts legibility. Use a calm crop and keep copy short.
antiPatterns.example: } title="One short line" />

accessibility.implementation: Renders h1 by default and accepts level={2}
accessibility.userRequirements: Keep exactly one h1 per page and a sequential outline below it

accessibility.implementation: Media is a slot; the consumer controls alt text
accessibility.userRequirements: Give informative images alt text and mark decorative media aria-hidden

compositionRules.relationship: Hero sits inside Section; Section owns tone and padding
Put one primary and at most one secondary action in actions
